title: Spot Spec
description: The file-based contract between src/spot_spec_export.py (producer) and cfr_solver/ (consumer). No shared Python code — this schema is the single source of truth for the shape.

spot_id.description: Unique identifier; also used as the output filename stem.

fingerprint_type.description: The 12-column fingerprint tuple this spec was derived from (see CLAUDE.md `fingerprints` schema / src/fingerprint.py).

n_matching_hands.description: How many real hands this spec was derived from (sample-size floor enforced upstream in spot_priority.py, default >= 30).

effective_stack_bb.description: Median (not mean, to avoid all-in outlier skew) of min(remaining stacks) / big_blind across matching hands, at the start of `street`.

pot_bb_at_street_start.description: Median pot size in BB at the start of `street`.

action_abstraction.description: 'push_fold': only fold/check-or-call/all-in are legal (no intermediate bet sizes). 'bet_buckets': a handful of pot-fraction bet sizes per street, derived from observed bets in matching real hands (src/spot_spec_export.py:_derive_bet_size_fractions). Consumed by cfr_solver/texas_adapter.py's set_bet_sizes.

board.description: Concrete representative board as a concatenated card string (e.g. '4c8h9dAc'), or null for preflop. Chosen as the most common actual board among matching hands sharing this fingerprint type — fingerprints only store a texture bucket, not real cards, so one concrete instance is picked for solving.

ranges.description: Static range-chart percentages (src/range_charts.py) for OOP/IP, e.g. {'oop': {'position': 'BB', 'range_pct': 40}, 'ip': {...}}. Fed into cfr_solver/texas_adapter.py's set_range_oop/set_range_ip so hole cards are dealt from each seat's realistic range rather than uniformly. May be null/omitted when the chart doesn't cover this facing/pot_type.
